title: The 10 Candle Hacks That Saved Me $100s

beats.sentence: Hack one. Buy your soy wax in ten pound bags, not little one pound boxes. The same wax costs less than half the price.

beats.sentence: Hack seven. Warm your jars in the oven before pouring. It stops ugly wet spots and saves you from redoing the whole candle.

beats.sentence: Hack eight. Cure your candles for two full weeks before burning. A cured candle throws twice the scent, so you use far less oil.

beats.sentence: Hack nine. Always trim your wick to a quarter inch before each burn. It makes the candle last hours longer and saves you buying new ones.
